subject: Packaging tradeoffs for private deployment: ops bundling and discount path
messages:
From: Anna Lee <anna@clearstream.health>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-04T09:12:00Z
Subject: Private deployment pricing — quick clarifications

Ben — thanks for the demo yesterday. Procurement has two concrete asks before we can move to approvals: 1) can you simplify the SKU list so we can show one-line ops/retainer vs per-node costs, and 2) are there standard discount bands for multi-site commitments (we'd be doing 3 sites + centralized SRE). Platform fee is the sticking point for our CFO — they'd like to see a path to amortize or carveout the fee against implementation credits.

If you can send a short commercial layout (one-pager + a matrix) and an initial discount range we can circulate, that would be ideal. We're targeting the internal committee next week.

Anna
Anna Lee | Head of DevOps | Clearstream Health
Attachments: none
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lee <anna@clearstream.health>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-04T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing — quick clarifications

Anna — great to hear. Attaching a concise pricing matrix (see attachment) that shows three packaging options: Starter (pilot, single site), Standard (multi-site w/ central SRE), and Enterprise (3+ sites, prioritized oncall). High level:
- Platform fee: can be amortized over 12–36 months or offset by implementation credits for the first year
- Support tiers: Silver (business hours), Gold (24/7 basic), Platinum (SRE-backed oncall)
- Discount bands: 10–20% off list based on commit and length; larger concessions for multi-year and committed node counts

I'll loop marissa and Olga for a consolidated concession path — we can propose a counter that maps to what procurement needs.

Attachment: privdeploy-pricing-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-04T17:30:00Z
Subject: Fwd: Private deployment pricing — quick clarifications

Ben — forwarding Anna's ask and your matrix. Quick internal thoughts (high level):

1) SKU consolidation: procurement wants a single ops line item they can put in their CapEx/OpEx request. Propose we present: 
   - "Platform Entitlement (annual)" + "Operational Retainer (monthly)" as the two lines, with node capacity as an appendix.

2) Platform fee amortization: offer a 12-month amortization by default for pilots; for enterprise commit we can stretch to 36 months but require a minimum annual commit.

3) Discounting approach: use a stair-step: 0–100 nodes: 10%, 101–500: 15%, 500+: 20% (adjust for multi-site claim). For their 3-site ask, recommend applying the 15% band if they commit to a 24-month term.

4) Implementation credits: offer up to 20% of year-1 platform fee as credits for professional services (applied as invoice credits).

Can you approve we present the above as the "programmatic" offer? Olga — can you prepare a single-page commercial that shows the two-line SKU, a short MAP (mutual action plan), and a suggested concession schedule? Need this by EOD tomorrow to hit their committee.

Marissa
VP - Commercial
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-05T10:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private deployment pricing — quick clarifications

Attaching the one-pager (ops-bundle-skus-v2.pdf) and a condensed concession table. Key points I put in the doc: 

- Consolidated billing layout (single entitlement line + ops retainer) with examples for 12/24/36 month terms.
- SKU consolidation reduces procurement friction; node counts nested in appendix so they stay invisible to finance reviewers.
- Proposed discounting band for this account (Clearstream / deal CS-4287):
   * Pilot (12 mo, single site): 8% off platform + 10% PS credit cap
   * Multi-site (3 sites, 24 mo commit): 15% off platform + 20% PS credit cap
   * Enterprise (>=3 sites, 36 mo): 20% off platform, 30% PS credit cap + waived onboarding fee

- Support routing: map support tiers to response SLAs; recommended default for Clearstream is Gold (24/7 basic) with option to add Platinum SRE support as a priced add-on.

- Risk mitigations: include a rollback clause (30-day cancellation with pro-rata refund of platform fee for non-delivery) and predefined service credits tied to latency/availability thresholds.

Attachments: ops-bundle-skus-v2.pdf (one-pager), concession-table.csv (spreadsheet)

Notes: I left placeholder numbers in the concession table for legal to review; this keeps our ability to tier discounts by exact node counts. Let me know if we should soften PS credit caps for procurement.

Olga
Principal Pricing Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lee <anna@clearstream.health>, procure@clearstream.health
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-06T14:43:00Z
Subject: Packaging proposal and next steps (Clearstream Health — CS-4287)

Anna / procurement team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Attached is the one-page commercial that consolidates SKUs and shows the three packaging options (Starter / Multi-site / Enterprise) plus the concession bands we discussed. Highlights tailored for Clearstream: 

- Recommended: Multi-site (3 sites) on a 24-month term
  * Platform fee after 15% discount
  * 20% PS credit cap applied to first-year platform fee (to help offset implementation entries)
  * Gold support included; option to add Platinum SRE for a fixed monthly retainer

- We can amortize the platform fee over 24 months on the invoice to aid your finance team; we'll reflect that in the SOW.

Next steps:
1) If this aligns, we'll issue a commercial summary and SOW draft for legal.
2) I'll create a mutual action plan (critical milestones + owners) and a DocuSign package for signature. Link to draft: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na1&PowerFormId=abc123
3) HubSpot deal updated: HUB-8721 / CS-4287 — please confirm the expected procurement review date and any additional attachment they need.

If procurement wants a narrower PS credit cap or a stricter Platform fee amortization, we can model two scenarios quickly — please flag which is a stronger preference.

Ben Carter
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
Attachments: ops-bundle-skus-v2.pdf, privdeploy-pricing-matrix.xlsx
